title: Origin story: Nyame
description: Nyame is the supreme sky god of the Akan, creator of all things, who once lived close to earth until humanity's pounding fufu drove him higher into the sky. He set Anansi the impossible tasks for ownership of all stories — and honored the bargain when the spider succeeded.

title: Ability profile: Nyame
description: Ranked abilities: Creation — rank 100/100; Authority — rank 100/100; Distance — rank 99/100; Bargain-keeping — rank 97/100; Judgment — rank 93/100.

title: Power ranking: Nyame
description: Powers: The sky itself as his being; Creation at a word; The wager honored — even with a spider.

title: Stamina feats: Nyame
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Has watched from the sky since creation; Endures humanity's noise with patience.

title: Crossover notes: Nyame
description: Nyame crosses naturally with: the sky, creation, ultimate authority, stories' source.

title: Cultural impact: Nyame
description: The high god who keeps his bargains; the source of all stories.

title: Generator record: Nyame
description: This record documents the boundless generator for Nyame's database.
